faqs.a: The tool uses the Web Speech API built into your browser, so no files are sent or stored anywhere. Your text stays on your device.
Voices come from your operating system and browser. Installing extra language packs or voices on your device adds more options here.
faqs.q: How do I get more voices?

faqs.a: Not directly - the browser plays the speech through your speakers. Use your device's screen recorder or an audio recorder app if you need a file.
faqs.q: Can I download the speech as audio?

faqs.a: Speech synthesis is designed for clear narration, not music. It reads the characters as spoken words, so a song's rhythm and melody are not reproduced.
faqs.q: Can it sing or read song lyrics well?

faqs.a: Yes, it works in Chrome, Edge, Safari and Firefox on desktop and mobile. Voice availability varies by device.
Yes. Hindi, Arabic and other languages work with the right voice installed. Pick a matching voice from the list for the best pronunciation.
faqs.q: Does it support Hindi and Arabic?

text-to-speech.formula:
words = text split on whitespace
estimated_seconds = (words / (150 x rate)) x 60
(everything happens on-device via the Web Speech API)
howTo: Type or paste your text into the box (up to 5,000 characters).
Pick a voice from the list. If the list is empty, your browser will use its default voice.
Adjust speed (0.5x to 2x), pitch and volume with the sliders.
Press Speak to hear the text read aloud. Use Pause, Resume and Stop to control playback.
Try a different voice for another language - a matching voice gives the best pronunciation.
keyFacts: Text to Speech uses the Web Speech API built into every modern browser - no downloads needed.
Voices are provided by your operating system and browser, not by the website.
Speed is adjustable from 0.5x (half speed) to 2x (double speed).
The estimated duration assumes about 150 words per minute at normal speed.
Punctuation like commas and full stops creates natural pauses in the narration.
Some browsers need voices to finish loading - if the list is empty, wait a moment or refresh.

text-to-speech.quickAnswer: Type or paste up to 5,000 characters, pick a voice, then press Speak. Your browser reads the text aloud using its built-in speech engine, with adjustable speed, pitch and volume. Pause, resume and stop controls are included, and an estimated reading time is shown.
text-to-speech.tagline: Type text and hear it read aloud instantly. Free, private, and right in your browser.
text-to-speech.workedExample:
Type a 300-word paragraph and press Speak at 1.0x speed.
Estimated time = (300 / (150 x 1.0)) x 60 = 120 seconds, or 2 minutes.
At 2.0x speed: (300 / (150 x 2.0)) x 60 = 60 seconds, exactly 1 minute.
The word counter and estimate update live as you type.
